description: WeWrite Matrix is an advanced Power BI visual that offers direct data write-back capabilities. By integrating data entry, planning, and analysis within Power BI, WeWrite empowers you to make informed decisions, optimize planning processes, and elevate your business growth potential. Say goodbye to Excel headaches and hello to a more streamlined, efficient, and effective data ecosystem. Supported databases: Microsoft SQL on-premises/cloud Azure SQL Fabric Warehouse MySQL PostgreSQL Snowflake If you have a specific database that you want to writeback to and it is not on our list, send us a feature request HERE. User-Friendly Planning Modules Gone are the days of complex planning processes that bring down your team's productivity. WeWrite enables the creation of user-friendly planning modules that facilitate collaboration among your team members. The result? A planning process that becomes a breeze, leading to well-structured plans that can drive up to a 40% increase in business growth. Don't settle for less; with WeWrite, you can forecast, budget, and strategize effortlessly, ensuring your business stays ahead of the curve. Supported features: Distribution of numbers across the hierarchy Adjust data -> numbers, text or date Plan versioning Locking columns Edit mode Quick calculations (absolute and relative) Power BI native-like design Row Level Security Audit logs Custom scripts…
